Services

We care for every stage of your oral health

From your first check-up to specialized treatments, with appointments that fit your schedule.

Diagnosis

A complete check of your teeth and gums to catch cavities and other problems early and agree on your treatment plan.

25 minBook this service

Dental cleaning

We remove the tartar and plaque your brush can’t reach, helping prevent bleeding gums and bad breath.

25 minBook this service

Dental filling

We restore decayed or chipped teeth with quality materials that blend naturally into your smile.

40 minBook this service

Root canal

Root canal treatment to save an infected or very painful tooth instead of removing it.

1 hBook this service

Tooth extraction

Careful removal of teeth that can no longer be saved, with local anesthesia and follow-up during recovery.

30 minBook this service

Wisdom tooth surgery

Planned removal of wisdom teeth that hurt, lack space or grow at an angle.

1 h 15 minBook this service

Teeth whitening

Safely brightens the shade of your teeth under professional supervision for a more radiant smile.

1 h 15 minBook this service

About us

A healthy smile is part of your well-being

At Dental Gert we believe a healthy smile is a fundamental part of everyone’s well-being and confidence. Since day one we have focused on comprehensive, personalized dental care, making sure every patient receives quality service and a positive experience.

With 6 to 10 years of practice, we work with commitment, trust and human warmth, offering dental solutions for the whole family. We stand out for our friendly care, individual attention and the quality of the materials we use.

We are located in Colonia Médica, San Salvador.

Dental Gert — Your smile’s best ally.

To raise our community’s well-being through personalized, excellent dental care. We focus on early detection and on teaching good oral hygiene habits. Through specialized treatments and rehabilitation, we aim to relieve pain, restore oral function and support a harmonious smile that strengthens each patient’s confidence and self-esteem.

To be a dental clinic recognized by local and international patients for the quality of our services and our commitment to the satisfaction of those who trust us.

At Dental Gert, every patient deserves close, professional care adapted to their needs. Our commitment is to accompany you in caring for your oral health so you can smile with peace of mind and confidence.

  • Friendly careWe listen and explain every step.
  • Individual attentionA plan designed for you, not a generic protocol.
  • Quality materialsReliable, long-lasting materials in every procedure.
  • For the whole familyWe care for smiles of all ages.

FAQ

Answers before your visit

Message us on WhatsApp

How do I book an appointment?

Choose the service, date and time in the form on this page and fill in your details. Your appointment is confirmed instantly and, if you leave your email, you get a Google Calendar invitation. You can also message us on WhatsApp at +503 7739 0440.

Can I change or cancel my appointment?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp at +503 7739 0440 as early as possible so we can offer the time to another patient.

I’m in pain, can you see me soon?

Message us on WhatsApp describing how you feel and we’ll find the first available slot. Online you can book as soon as two hours ahead.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Your ID or passport, a list of medications you take and, if you have them, X-rays or reports from previous treatments. Please arrive 10 minutes early.

Do you treat children?

Yes, we offer dental care for the whole family.

Do you treat international patients?

Yes. In the form choose “Foreign visitor” and enter your passport and phone number with your country code.

How long does each treatment take?

Diagnosis and cleaning: 25 min. Filling: 40 min. Extraction: 30 min. Root canal: 1 h. Wisdom tooth surgery and whitening: 1 h 15 min. Times are approximate per visit.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Message us on WhatsApp and we’ll confirm the available payment methods.

What are your opening hours?

Monday to Friday 8:00 am – 12:00 pm and 1:30 pm – 4:30 pm. Saturday 8:00 am – 1:00 pm. Closed on Sundays.
